evidence: The thickness of the Ru films were determined by cross-sectional view transmission electron microscopy (XTEM, Tecnai F20 equipped with 200 kV accelerating voltage and field emission gun) analysis. The nucleation behavior of ALD-Ru as a function of the number of ALD cycles were evaluated using plan-view TEM analysis. The step coverage of the ALD-Ru films was evaluated at contacts or trenches with different aspect ratios. The morphology of electroplated Cu was examined by cross-sectional view scanning electron microscopy.
